analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported robust financial results for H1 FY26, with revenue of Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA of Rs. 13.43 crore, and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crore, representing a 49.08% Y-o-Y increase in revenue and 46.66% in PAT. Management highlighted progress in expanding product portfolios, including new segments like edible oils and upcoming launches in soya chunks and puja devotional items.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the second half of the year will be better than the first half.
guidance.quote: So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.
guidance.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management noted that the oil division will see better performance and pick up in H2.
guidance.quote: So, H2 will be better in the Oil. So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

demand_outlook.claim: Management described the demand environment as encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of approximately 6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that 70% of the spices and atta markets are currently unorganized.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company plans to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading, and distribution of puja articles and devotional goods.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company plans to expand manufacturing for soya chunks with a plant installation after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and introduced its products in Mumbai on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its edible oil segment with a new manufacturing facility starting commercial production on 10th May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: and we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14% for H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven and not making losses.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that monthly media and channel advertisement expenditures are approximately Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05%.
The profit margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 9.14%.
Net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming six months of depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Still the one thing I want to focus and just give the clarity on that. Our PAT has been decreased. See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the installed capacity for Spices is 3,600 tons with a utilization of 2,637 tons, Atta capacity is 14,400 tons with a utilization of 12,650 tons, and Oil capacity is 7,200 tons with a utilization of 720 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons. And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons. When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for spices and masalas stands at 3,600 tons per annum with utilization at 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum with 12,650 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for oil is 7,200 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that short-term borrowings increased primarily due to an overdraft on the last day of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the new puja and devotional products vertical is planned to be launched in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company plans to target 30% capacity utilization for the oil segment in H2.
management_commitments.quote: I think next financial year, H2 will be utilized almost 30% easily. We can reach up to 30%. Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that expansion plans for Atta and Spices will be considered within two years.
management_commitments.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan. It will take some time. After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that all oil products will be placed in complete marketplaces by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: All the oil product will be placed in the complete marketplaces.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
